title: Subtraction commutes with expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f,g\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The uniform expectation of their pointwise difference equals the difference of their uniform expectations: $\E_x[f(x)-g(x)]=\E_x[f(x)]-\E_x[g(x)]$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$.
Then $\mathbb E[f-g]=\mathbb E[f]-\mathbb E[g]$, where $(f-g)(x)=f(x)-g(x)$ and
$\mathbb E[h]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}h(x)$.
